q: What is the carbon footprint of a quick commerce dark store per order?
title: Dark store emissions per order
short: Cold rooms and freezers usually dominate a dark store's electricity, then lighting and cooling. Divide monthly electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, plus refrigerant leaks, by orders packed. Rider trips are a separate figure, Scope 1 or 3 depending on who runs the fleet.
audience: Quick commerce operators and store franchisees

ul: Electricity per month from the bill.

p: Keep rider fuel or charging separate so the store and delivery numbers can each be improved.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
